plan.method: Partition the fixed shared phase interval uniformly into128 adjacent closed subintervals. Apply the pointwise interval-distance MSE lower bound separately on each. If all128 lower bounds exceed zero-response MSE, no one shared phase in the original range can beat zero. Retain every interval and compare every bound vector against the independent bracketing-based calculation.
interpretationLimits: A common phase is fixed across all708 observations. The bound does not rule out mixtures spanning multiple subintervals.
